scientific.label: Elevation
scientific.title: Color shows height above the PDS 531 km reference sphere. Brightness shows fixed northwest relief lighting at true height scale; Shadows adds the shared approximate globe lighting. Cassini SPC model released in 2025, about 1.5 km grid spacing. The globe uses a simplified version of the released Q128 shape; grid and geometry resolutions differ. Model detail and accuracy vary.

scientific.label: Relative albedo
scientific.title: Relative brightness solved together with the Cassini SPC shape model, normalized around 1. This secondary model product is less validated than topography. It is neither visible color nor calibrated reflectance. Colors show 0.5–1.5; values above 1.5 saturate. Gray grid preserves source gaps.

celestial.sunSource: JPL Tethys orbit plus VSOP87 Saturn position and IAU/WGCCRE Tethys rotation

panel.introduction: An icy moon of Saturn marked by the enormous Odysseus crater and Ithaca Chasma, a vast canyon crossing its surface. The shape view reveals a simplified Cassini SPC model. Relative albedo shows the model’s brightness variation; elevation uses its own stated reference sphere.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Cassini 2012 mosaic, 293 m per source pixel, delivered on the shared 8192 × 4096 layout. Photographed shadows and variable resolution remain; globe Shadows add approximate lighting. Gray grid marks explicit source no-data. Mapped onto a simplified Cassini SPC shape; independent image control can leave local registration differences.
controls.title: Global image mosaic
controls.summary: Source pixels span 293 m in the 2012 mosaic. Shadows and uneven detail remain; the gray grid marks missing observations.

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: Published 2014 infrared–green–ultraviolet composite, photometrically corrected by Paul Schenk. Enhanced colors extend beyond human vision. Source resolution varies; seams and residual photographed shading remain. Mapped onto a simplified Cassini SPC shape; independent image control can leave local registration differences.
controls.title: Enhanced-color composite
controls.summary: Infrared, green and ultraviolet bands reveal colors beyond human vision. Detail varies; photographed shadows and seams remain.
